newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac sees fewer credit card issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac sees fewer credit card issue.

text.p: Competitive pressures was likely to lead to a rationalisation in the number of institutions issuing credit cards, the managing director of Westpac Banking Corp, Bob Joss said on Monday.
"Increasingly you are going to find that it's fewer, bigger players that are able to be in this business," Joss told reporters after a credit card launch in Sydney.
"Overall it (the credit card business) is a good business but a tough business where you need scale and processing efficiency," Joss said.
Joss said credit card issuers got different returns from different segments with some customers never borrowing on credit cards, using them as a payment vehicle only.
Joss said he was not concerned about the number of different credit cards that were available at the moment in Australia.
Earlier, Westpac, Ansett Airlines Ltd and Visa International jointly launched a credit card linked to the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games, called the Global Reward Westpac Visa card.
The companies said the card would allow holders to earn frequent flyer points as well as various benefits linked with the Olympic Games.
